scenes.heading: The Waiting Room
scenes.label: TWENTY MINUTES EARLY
scenes.narration: Leo arrived twenty minutes early for his interview. The man beside him wore muddy boots and carried a dented toolbox.

scenes.heading: A little room
scenes.label: STILL WAITING
scenes.narration: Leo moved his bag off the next chair. They talked while they waited.

scenes.heading: The next room
scenes.label: CALLED IN
scenes.narration: When the receptionist called Leo's name, the man stood too. Leo realised the stranger was the founder.

scenes.heading: The conversation
scenes.label: TEN MINUTES OF HONESTY
scenes.narration: Leo swallowed. He had spent ten minutes explaining everything wrong with the company's website.

scenes.heading: The notebook
scenes.label: ACROSS THE DESK
